update.title: Made nested blocks easier to edit
update.summary: Added an always-visible child control, click-outside deselection, and drag cleanup so groups follow the same editing rules as top-level blocks.

blocks.body:
## Add content directly inside a group

Every group now ends with an always-visible **Add sub-block** control. It opens the same block picker used elsewhere and inserts the selected block at the chosen position, including when the group is empty. A stronger accent edge keeps the group boundary visible while composing the page.

blocks.alt: Portfolio Editor preview showing two child blocks inside a purple-accented group with an always-visible Add sub-block control
blocks.caption: The permanent control keeps the next action visible at the end of every group, including after its current children.

blocks.body:
## Keep the preview interaction state clean

The live preview runs inside an iframe, so direct interactions pass through a small bridge to the Editor. Its click handler now yields to the injected add and insertion controls, empty-space clicks clear the current selection, and leaving the preview during a drag removes stale targets and insertion feedback.
